what_to_detect: A playability candidate whose cost uses cards exiled with its source (Forge: ExiledWithSource in the cost) is affordable and playable when a card its source's replacement effect exiled is in exile.
near_miss: The same candidate is unaffordable or unplayable because no card exiled with its source is in exile, though cards exiled by other sources are.
record_fields: sidecar script cost of the candidate line

what_to_detect: A permanent whose ability refers to the value chosen as it entered (protection from the chosen colour) is outside a candidate's legal targets when the candidate has the chosen value, read against the permanent's gen-3 chosen field.
near_miss: The same permanent is inside the legal targets of a candidate that does not have the chosen value.

what_to_detect: A triggered ability linked to a static ability in the same paragraph triggers on what that static did: the static's reveal resolves, its condition on the revealed card is met, and the linked trigger (Forge: an ImmediateTrigger) is created and fires.
near_miss: The static's reveal resolves but the revealed card does not meet the linked trigger's condition; the condition is unmet and no linked trigger fires.

what_to_detect: A permanent spell cast with a variable additional cost paid N times resolves and its linked ability's magnitude (the counters it enters with) equals N.
near_miss: The same kind of spell cast with the cost paid a different number of times, or not at all, gets that number instead.
record_fields: gen-3 card lines cast_with (optional costs paid)

what_to_detect: An ability preceded by an anchor word applies only when that word was chosen as its permanent entered: the trigger it grants fires on a permanent whose chosen anchor word is that one.
near_miss: A permanent whose other anchor word was chosen: the gated static is inactive and the trigger does not exist, so no such trigger record is written.
record_fields: gen-3 card lines active (statics), chosen, granted

what_to_detect: A permanent's ability referring to cards exiled with it acts on the cards exiled to pay its spell's cost as well as those its own abilities exiled, all of them linked to it in the snapshot's exiled_with edges.
near_miss: A card exiled by an unrelated source has no exiled_with edge to the permanent and is not moved.

what_to_detect: A permanent that gained an ability referring to a choice without a choice made for it (no gen-3 chosen value) gets nothing from that part: protection from the chosen colour does not apply and it is inside a candidate's legal targets.
near_miss: A permanent with the same ability and a choice made is outside the legal targets of a candidate of the chosen value.
